استمررت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْرَرْتُ (istamrartu) /is.tam.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
# اِسْتَمْرَرْتَ (istamrarta) /is.tam.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
# اِسْتَمْرَرْتِ (istamrarti) /is.tam.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
# اُسْتُمْرِرْتُ (ustumrirtu) /us.tum.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
